samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend input signal representing the number to be divided.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor input signal representing the number by which to divide.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Indicates the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Contains the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <implementation>
        When opn_valid is high and res_valid is low, save the inputs dividend and divisor.
        Initialize the shift register SR with the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit.
        Set NEG_DIVISOR to the negated absolute value of the divisor.
        Set the counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1 to begin the division process.
        
        If start_cnt is high, perform the following steps:
            If cnt[7] is set, indicating that the most significant bit is set,
                clear cnt and start_cnt.
                Update SR with the final remainder and quotient.
            Otherwise, increment the counter cnt.
            Perform subtraction based on the current state of the counter cnt and update SR accordingly.
    </implementation>
</module>
